title: Animated code blocks
description: Highlights fenced code at build time with Shiki in light and dark themes, so the browser gets tokens and no highlighter: titles, line numbers, highlight steps, folds that hide lines until a step or a click opens them, diffs that switch between one column and before and after side by side, and Shiki notation comments in CodeBlock, tabs for several files, code read from a file, a line range or a #region so it keeps compiling, and code that shrinks to fit its slide or scrolls to what is highlighted. Magic moves morph code between versions token by token and mark the lines that changed, and a diff can play as one.

context_before: While `pnpm dev` runs, a slide whose content does not fit says so in its top corner, in red, and content shrunk to fit says so in amber.
added: Fenced code is highlighted at build time by [Shiki](https://shiki.style), so the browser receives coloured tokens and never loads a highlighter. The two themes are set in `plugins/shiki.ts`; both are compiled in and follow the deck's light or dark mode.
| `title="src/app.ts"`          | Title bar with the file name and a copy button                                     |
| `{2,4-6}`                     | Highlights those lines and dims the rest                                           |
| `{1\|3-4\|all}`               | One highlight per step; end on `all`, since print shows the last                   |
| `file="./snippets/app.ts"`    | The code of a real file, updated when it changes; `#L10-24` or `#name` for part    |
| `maxLines=10`                 | At most that many lines, scrolled to what is highlighted                           |
| `fold={4-11}`                 | Those lines behind one `⋯ 8 lines` line; `fold=#name` folds a region of `file=`    |
| `diff`                        | Lines starting with `+` or `-` are added or removed; `git diff` output works as is |
| `diff split`                  | The same, starting with before and after side by side                              |
| `diff magic-move`             | Plays the diff from before to after in one step                                    |

`file="…"` is relative to the file the fence is in, and `#name` reads the lines between `// #region name` and `// #endregion` (the markers are left out). Code the talk shows can live in `snippets/`, which `pnpm typecheck` checks with the rest of the deck, so it keeps compiling.

Code that is too tall or too wide for its slide shrinks to fit, down to 80%, which the slide's corner shows while `pnpm dev` runs; past that it overflows. Split the slide, cut the code, fold what is not the point, or give it `maxLines`.

A fold hides lines behind one line, `⋯ 8 lines`, and keeps the code whole: the copy button copies all of it. A step whose highlight falls inside a fold opens it, and the next step shuts it again; `all` leaves folds shut, so the printed slide keeps its size. A click on the folded line opens it too, until the next step. Line numbers skip what a fold hides, and a fold must fit the slide once it is open.

Every `diff` whose lines fit half the width has a Unified | Split switch in its title bar, shown on hover. Switching slides each line to its side, unchanged ones into both, and highlights and folds work either way; `diff split` starts side by side.
Several fences inside `<CodeTabs>` become tabs: their highlight steps play in order, and a tab can be picked by hand.

Shiki's notation comments work in every language and disappear from the slide: `// [!code ++]`, `// [!code --]`, `// [!code highlight]`, `// [!code focus]`, `// [!code error]`, `// [!code warning]` and `// [!code word:name]`.

A magic move morphs code from one version to the next: tokens that stay move to their new place, the rest fade out or in, and lines holding new text are marked. Put the versions in a four-backtick `md magic-move` fence; each version is a step, and a version's own `{…}` highlights add steps after it.
Highlighted when the deck builds, animated when it plays.
